ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels in the central region and 20% low-intensity black pixels along the margins and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous high-intensity white field; solid low-intensity black banding along the entire superior trailing edge; dark pigmentation expansion at both distal tips; irregular dark cluster at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 60 to 70 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the total fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated superior boundary; high-frequency micro-peaks along the left lobe trailing edge; distinct notch-like indentation on the distal half of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex-upward sweep from the central notch to the tips; the distal tips exhibit a sharp posterior-lateral orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular low-intensity clusters on the mid-right lobe; one smaller circular cluster on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of three to four fine, horizontal dark-pixel lines visible on the central-left lobe white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular notches and tissue loss on the trailing edge; multiple focal dark spots consistent with barnacle detachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric distribution of black pigment at distal tips, with the right tip exhibiting a broader low-intensity region than the left.
